goal: Implement Slice S1 of docs/specs/parallel-batch-lanes.spec.md (Initiative parallel-batch-lanes): the Batch Plan projection reports parallel groups and scope conflicts, and one pure scheduling function returns the startable set for a batch record. No tool parameter, no persisted-state change, no change to serial batch behavior.

acceptance.assertion: Per the Scheduling rule under State transitions of docs/specs/parallel-batch-lanes.spec.md (Initiative parallel-batch-lanes) (sources: user decision D5, delegated disjointness rule): a pure function in runtime/unattended/batch_schedule.ts returns the startable children for given child states, blocked_by edges, scope_hint lists and max_parallel, and the Batch Plan projection additively reports parallel groups and the children that serialize because their scopes overlap. plan_digest and every existing plan field are unchanged for an existing Initiative. Positive: ready children with disjoint scopes start together up to the limit. Negative: identical, prefix-nested and wildcard-pattern scopes are treated as overlapping and serialize; a child with an unmet blocked_by never starts; a pattern with an empty literal prefix overlaps everything. Bound: max_parallel 1 yields exactly the current serial order. Agreed seams: tests/unattended-batch-schedule.test.ts (new), tests/unattended-batch-plan.test.ts.
